text:
Eve: quick thought — can we standardize a really small "compact resume token" for both paged HTTP+streaming so retries + resume are identical across SDKs?
Jordi: yes please. current tokens are huge JSON blobs, messy in URLs and SDKs.
Priya: what's the minimum we need in the token? cursor, seq, model id?
Eve: MVP proposal: 1 byte version | model_id (short id) | cursor bytes | 4 byte crc32 | optional hmac. then base64url-encode. e.g. v1. makes it opaque but tiny.
Kai: +1 on size. two tradeoffs: opaque bytes -> no client introspection; structured -> easier debugging and back-compat.
Jordi: for SDK ergonomics: expose a ResumeToken class with .toString() and static fromString(); keep internals hidden by default but allow a debug.parse(token) that returns a dict for a logged-in dev.
Priya: language differences: Python/TS should use str (base64url). Go should use type ResumeToken string. parsing helpers in all three.
Eve: transport consistency: streaming (grpc/http2) will include resume_token in the reconnection handshake; paged HTTP will pass ?cursor=<token>. we must ensure URL-safe base64.
Kai: what about idempotency across retries? token must be sticky to a server-side snapshot id or session nonce so server can detect duplicate delivery. that's the optional hmac in the proposal.
Jordi: signing is tricky for hosted vs private deployments (customers might want to sign with their KMS). optional is fine. keep unsigned common-case so easier to inspect.
Priya: SDK API surface suggestion: listResponses(params) -> iterator that yields items and exposes .resume_token on the iterator when paused. also provide resume=token param to constructor.
Eve: example TS surface: 
```ts
const it = client.listResponses({model: 'rwd-v1', page_size: 64});
for await (const msg of it) { /* ... */ }
// pause -> const token = it.resumeToken;
```
Jordi: Python analogous: 
```py
it = client.list_responses(model='rwd-v1', page_size=64)
for msg in it:
    ...
# token = it.resume_token
```
Kai: Go: 
```go
it := client.ListResponses(ctx, &ListOpts{Model: "rwd-v1", PageSize: 64})
for it.Next() { msg := it.Item() }
// token := it.ResumeToken()
```
Priya: edge cases: server may evict the cursor -> resume attempt returns 410 with a small payload suggesting fallback (start over or request snapshot id). SDK should translate to a clear exception/err type, not opaque 4xx.
Eve: retry semantics: if resume fails with transient network error -> retry reconnect; if server says token expired -> surface ResumeExpired error with the server-provided hint.
Jordi: metrics: record token_size, resume_attempts, resume_success rate (per model). important for Optimize tool.
Kai: compatibility: include a version byte at start so we can evolve without breaking old clients. server should accept older versions and map them.
Priya: one more SDK nicety — implement a small `ResumeToken.debug()` which, when SDK is in dev mode, will print the parsed components but only if token unsigned or if user passed `allowDebug=true`. avoids leaking secrets.
Eve: deployment note: for private installs we should allow `sign_with_kms: true` in admin config so tokens are HMACed by customer key.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolling-deploy scheduled for infra:resume-token-v1 on 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC :white_check_mark:
Jordi: next steps: write a tiny spec (1 page) with binary layout, base64url rules, and SDK helper prototypes. I'll draft and request reviews from SDK owners.
Priya: happy to take TS + Python helpers. Kai will cover Go.
Eve: thanks — aim to land RFC follow-up by EOW so eng-releases can schedule. :rocket:
